files.description: Verifies photo details page (/media/view/14) displays file information correctly including file name, folder path, main image (served from /media/14), and Open File / Open Folder action buttons

Verifies people and faces sections display correctly with counts, person links (a.person-link -> /people/{id}/faces), and face thumbnails on photo 4 (which has several detected faces), and tests face hover highlighting
Tests adding tags on photo 14 through the Edit Tags modal; tags are saved wholesale via PUT /api/media/{id}/tags and the page reloads; cleanup restores the pre-test tag set via the same PUT endpoint
Verifies location section displays coordinates (rendered with degree symbols, e.g. 43.467448°, 11.885127°) and Google Maps link correctly when location data is available (photo 14 has GPS data)

Tests face hover functionality on photo 7 - waits for the main photo to load (highlight geometry is scaled from naturalWidth and the canvas is sized from the rendered photo), then hovering over face thumbnails highlights the face on the #faceCanvas overlay and clears on mouse leave

Responsive coverage for the media detail viewer: contract-width containment, narrow stacking and scroll ownership, rotation with dynamic viewport units, coarse-pointer face highlighting and redraw, the tag dialog at 320px, long paths, playable and missing-video states, and touch-sized metadata actions.

testContext:
These tests are for the photo details page of a Flask photo organizer. ROUTES: details page is /media/view/{media_item_id} (renamed from /photo/view/{id}); the image binary is /media/{id} (was /photos/{id}); face thumbnails are /faces/{face_id}. Tags are managed wholesale via PUT /api/media/{id}/tags with body {tags: [{tag_name, tag_value}]} — there is NO per-tag delete endpoint anymore; saving closes the modal and reloads the page. The tags modal is #tagsModal with title #tagsModalTitle. Seeded test data: photo 14 is DSCN0010.jpg with GPS coordinates but no faces; photo 7 and photo 4 have detected faces. Coordinates display with degree symbols ('43.467448°, 11.885127°'), so regexes must allow °. Detail sections are .detail-section blocks; both File Information and Location sections can contain a 'Name:' .detail-item, so scope lookups to the section. Section headings pluralize ('Person (1)' vs 'People (2)', 'Face (1)' vs 'Faces (9)'). Face hover: .face-thumbnail[data-face-id] mouseenter draws on #faceCanvas and adds .highlighted; drawing depends on #mainPhoto being loaded (naturalWidth > 0) and the canvas being sized, so wait for that before hovering.

RESPONSIVE (2026-08-30): shared assertions come from generated_tests/_support/responsive.ts. Below 900px the viewer stacks with .photo-container ordered above .photo-sidebar, the sidebar drops its sticky card and internal scroller (the document is the only scroller), and the media is capped in dvh (62dvh, 78dvh on short landscape viewports). A mouse-driven highlight is ended by the mouseleave a reflow itself fires, so rotation cases must run in a touch context. Tapping a face thumbnail highlights it (view.js) as well as opening the reassign overlay (face-reassign.js).
explanation: 2026-07-01: Fixed after the JS testing migration + photos→media rename. All specs now navigate to /media/view/{id}; the file-info test requests /media/14; the people/faces test moved to photo 4 (photo 14 has no faces) and uses a.person-link with /people/{id}/faces hrefs; the location test accepts degree symbols in displayed coordinates; the tags test uses the new #tagsModalTitle id, waits on the PUT /api/media/{id}/tags response, and restores the original tag set in afterEach (the old DELETE /api/photo/tags/{id} endpoint is gone); the face-hover test waits for the image + canvas to be ready before asserting canvas pixels. All 5 tests pass.
